ruleDefinitions.name: Change to Authentication Method
ruleDefinitions.description: Change to authentication method could be an indicator of an attacker adding an auth method to the account so they can have continued access. Note: Unmapped fields: LoggedByService, Category, OperationName

sequences.query: (LoggedByService = "Authentication\ Methods" AND Category = "UserManagement" AND OperationName = "User\ registered\ security\ info")
